This is the first time I use this, so bear with, plz. 
Wizard OC from our family's DnD sessions.
A lazy, poor, unremarkable scholar who shies away from direct combat or difficult/dangerous things. She's in her mid 30's. She has no problem running away or using underhand tactics.  I included some of the doodles i did of her while we played DnD, the one with color is made by my sister.
Basically your average depressed university student/teacher.
She actually filled her teeth to make them sharp honoring a tradition from her village, she also blackens them with an iron solution like many cultures arround the world do, that is to say, she's a regular human not a shark girl or something.
She often wears two messy buns on her hair. She has a hat with half a skeleton inside it but for this better to draw her without hat. Her robes are black, old, dirty oversized hand me downs previously owned by her father, with kind of a high polo neck shirt underneath.
I would like the teeth to show if possible cause she's proud of them, even if some people find it weird or off putting. Her lips are often a bit stained with the blackening substance cause she's not careful when applying it.
Her nails are painted black, she's often barefoot, but you can give her shoes if you wanna.
She seems to always be running on only two hours of sleep and pretty malnourished. Has bags under her black eyes, she's pale, she has a bit of a big mouth both literally and figuratively but it's not that important.
She doesn't wear any jewels.
Her staff is a skull on a spine.
She is quite short, and thin, but besides that her looks vary a bit from doodle to doodle so you can go with your gut too, tho she's not supposed to be very cute or conventionally attractive, but you can make her cute if you want.
She likes to read and study a lot, so maybe have her with a book or something. 
she's a wizard but not at all powerful, so she won't be doing some flashy arcane magic or somnt.
I know she's not much your style, so don't worry if you feel like you don't wanna do her, it's ok.

The situation: Super Meche is in her innermost private chamber, where no underling would ever be allowed to even peek inside. She is trying on a brand new cosplay of Sakura Miko from hololive! Absolutely engrossed in it, taking selfies left and right, she doesn't notice the sounds of combat reverberating through the dungeon, until suddenly! The door bursts in, and there stands The Hero!? But the real surprise is what he then yells, "There you are, I finally found you, my party's priest! Come with me back up to the surface to recuperate!"
Yes, the hero has mistaken Super Meche in Miko cosplay as being his party's lost priest.

The request: From the Hero's point of view, Super Meche is being flustered and internally debating whether to play along for a chance to spend time with the Hero, or be honest as she is wont to be, and try to clear up the misunderstanding.
Super Meche is recovering balance from standing with one leg lifted, trying to pose like Sakura Miko often does to be cute, arms somewhat spread. She is holding a smartphone in one hand since she has just been taking selfies. She has her normal hair color (not wearing a wig), but is wearing the hair accessory.

(Note: This idea was thought up before seeing the recent miko outfit Meche artwork. I would like to request Sakura Miko's more unique 2019 outfit, as in the reference.)
